scope: Published Financial Literacy questions reviewed from production API

summary.reasonForPriority: Several questions contain jurisdiction-specific claims that must be checked against current UK sources before learners rely on them.

reviewQueue.action: Verify against the current official FSCS protection limit; correct the answer, explanation, and distractors if outdated.
Verify against the current official FSCS protection limit and reconcile with the conflicting £50,000 item.
Replace with the appropriate UK pension terminology or explicitly label the comparison as US-specific.

reviewQueue.issue: FDIC terminology appears in a UK financial-literacy explanation
reviewQueue.action: Rewrite around FSCS for a UK learner; retain FDIC only if the learning objective is an explicit international comparison.

reviewQueue.issue: PDS terminology appears in the track
reviewQueue.action: Confirm the intended jurisdiction and replace PDS with the appropriate UK document or explain the term for a UK learner.

reviewQueue.issue: Absolute or over-broad claims: money-market accounts have the highest interest; building societies offer better rates; fixed expenses never change; APR is simply yearly interest on loans or savings
reviewQueue.action: Rewrite as conditional, sourceable statements and align each explanation with the exact question objective.

nearDuplicateReview.pattern: FSCS maximum protection per person in a UK bank
nearDuplicateReview.action: Keep one canonical question after the limit is verified; retire the lightly reworded duplicate.

nearDuplicateReview.pattern: Main purpose / purpose of a payslip
nearDuplicateReview.action: Merge or differentiate by objective; avoid testing the same recall point twice.

nearDuplicateReview.pattern: Benefit / advantage of a good credit score
nearDuplicateReview.action: Merge or give the second item a distinct applied scenario.

approvalRule: Do not publish corrections until the answer, explanation, distractors, and UK source citation have been checked together.

authoritativeSources.title: FSCS deposit protection limit increase
authoritativeSources.note: The official FSCS page states that the limit rose to £120,000 on 1 December 2025.
